export_frame_face_points_along_rotated_f.note: area-weighted mean normal of the face part in the re-imported FBX, before undoing the rotation

orientation_inside_out_parts_as_profile.note: ray-escape score < -0.5 on the Tripo geometry

expected.other: only at vertices of near-degenerate triangles (< 0.0001 cm2)

reference_corner_normals_rotated_consist.note: corner normals equal the unrotated reference (|dot| > 0.999) after undoing the export rotation, negated only on the parts whose winding this candidate fixes. Exception, reported per corner: the face normal of a sliver triangle is numerically undefined: the export rotation (even an exact axis permutation changes the float summation order) changes it and shifts the exported normals of the corners that share its vertices (measured: not caused by Triangulate)

reference_v2_winding_differs_only_in_new.note: the reference fixed ['tripo_part_10', 'tripo_part_14'] only; any other inside-out part is expected to differ fully

roundtrip_scale_ratio_1.note: Blender re-reads the cm FBX (UnitScaleFactor 1.0) as metres

triangulate_changes_no_geometry.note: preset use_triangles=True; the meshes are already all triangles, so Triangulate is a no-op

uv0_inside_own_atlas_cell.note: every UV corner lies in its part's inner cell rect (gutter kept)

uv0_raster_overlap_measured.note: informational: texels covered by >= 2 triangles / covered texels, per part at atlas resolution

expected_ue_bounds_uu_at_import_scale_1.note: *_blender_axes: authored Blender frame (front -Y), centimetres; *_export_frame: as written into the FBX (re-imported); *_ue_predicted: export frame mapped as UE (x, -y, z) per ART-001. ue-import measures the real mapping

deviations_from_preset.bake_anim: off: the candidate FBX carries no clips
deviations_from_preset.path_mode: STRIP instead of AUTO: bare texture names; textures reach UE from the atlas stage, not through the FBX

figure.note: whole-figure flow: the figure (with base) is scaled to the profile height; the skeletal top is the figure top

face_slot.note: second slot kept for parity with face-section-neck-v2; both slots use the same atlas material in UE

not_checked: art acceptance, silhouette, lighting, K1/K2/K3 (art track)
deformation quality in animation; clips are not built by this stage
budgets: numbers are measured only (proposals until GD-058)
UV intra-part island padding (Tripo's own layout inside each cell)
UE-side facing: measured by ue-import (bounds axis map) and editor frames, not here

base.precision: positions 1e-4 m, UV 1e-5, material index; corner normals |dot| > 0.999

body.precision: positions 1e-4 m, UV 1e-5, material index; corner normals |dot| > 0.999

bow.precision: positions 1e-4 m, UV 1e-5, material index; corner normals |dot| > 0.999
